```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS ratio
FROM main.trans t
WHERE t.date >= '1997-01-01' 
    AND t.date <= '1997-12-31'
    AND t.date <= '1998-09-15'
```
